items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: he had Ed Thigpen, Doc Severinsen, Tony Scott on clarinet... I was the leader... We went up to Newport, you know, with Pat.

ctx.x: But you're improvising on your solo, usually. You're not improvising exactly in surgery, are you?

Yeah, well -- he told me sometimes the X-rays don't tell them all, and they go, when they go inside with a patient, and the guy that's got the talent to do it is the one that makes the patient survive. I says, "Oh, is that the reason, Doc?"
